bug_name: Zone Related Limits Can Be Bypassed in ZSwapV1
root_cause: Wrong Translation of Logic into Constraints
proposed_mitigation: The correct behavior when deltaTime exceeds the period is to reset `zAccountUtxoInTotalAmountPerTimePeriod` to 0 (new period) and re-check the cap against just `totalWeighted`, rather than collapsing the running total to 0. Fix the logic so the cap is enforced in every branch.

Audit Report.Bug ID: V-PAN-VUL-016: Zone related limits can be bypassed
